answer: Stamp every identity with a work pigment that only verified tasks can dye: each completed, peer-checked job adds one pigment layer tied to that job's hash, and earning rights grow with pigment depth, not with the number of accounts. A new identity starts umber-blank, earning almost nothing, while a gale of fresh Sybils stays pale because each layer costs a full verified task plus a small stake that burns if an audit fails. Pigment cannot be bought or transferred, so splitting one agent's work across a thousand fakes yields a thousand shallow identities instead of one deep, trusted one.
